packageRules.description: Everything in devDependencies except lit is build/lint/test tooling, safe to automerge on green CI. lit is excluded here: it is bundled into glp-card.js and glp-order-card.js, so it is a runtime dependency even though it sits in devDependencies (see the lit rule below).

lit is bundled into glp-card.js and glp-order-card.js by npm run build, so it ships to users as the card's runtime templating library even though it is declared in devDependencies. A bad release breaks the rendered card, so this rule deliberately has no automerge and updates are reviewed by hand.
requirements_test.txt is test/dev tooling only — manifest.json declares zero runtime pip dependencies. Safe to automerge on green CI (Pytest/Hassfest/HACS).
github/codeql-action's init/analyze/upload-sarif sub-actions must stay version-matched or the Analyze job fails (#141). Grouped together, CI-only, safe to automerge on green.
